FL-069.label: The core tools every modern harness has: files, terminal, Chrome, skills, changing models, compaction (our own take), and interactions with common apps, taken from the most modular standard source.

FL-069.observed: Real read, pwd, load_capability and loopback navigation/read_page succeeded (NOCTURNE title). Open web correctly refused before permission. Skill returned CEDAR but omitted required SKILL-MARKER prefix, so the complete gesture is not PASS.

FL-071.label: The location fence: an agent can edit only files in the exact directory it stands in, and its shell is kept to that subtree, enforced deterministically.

FL-071.observed: The real write tool refused ../beta/item.txt while in alpha, requiring presence in beta. File remained BIRCH. Trace retains the actual refusal.
